Alex Chen: quick check — I just saw a few 400s from /v1/generate related to the routing param. older mobile clients send routing_hint as a single string like "us-west:premium" and our API now expects an object. can we accept both?

Priya Nair: do you mean the field in the request body called `routing_hint`? current API contract expects: `{ "model": "rw-l1", "region": "us-west", "tier": "premium" }`

Jon Park: repro snippet from prod error logs:
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'region' of undefined
  at parseRouting (/srv/routing/index.js:42:18)
  ...
```
Example bad payload we received: `{ "prompt": "hi", "routing_hint": "us-west:premium" }`

Marco Silva: sounds like a small parsing shim would work. fallback behavior we should enforce: 1) if `routing_hint` is object -> use fields; 2) if string with `:` -> parse as `region:tier`; 3) if string matching a model id -> treat as `model`; final fallback -> global default. pseudo: 
```js
function normalizeRouting(h){
  if(typeof h === 'object') return h;
  if(typeof h === 'string' && h.includes(':')){
    const [region,tier] = h.split(':');
    return { region, tier };
  }
  return { model: h };
}
```
This keeps backward compat and avoids breaking older clients.

Lisa Turner: will this require a contract bump? mobile SDKs have been shipping the string format for a while.

Priya Nair: no major contract bump if we accept both shapes. we should, however, emit a deprecation warning in the response headers when we parse legacy shapes so SDKs can be notified. also increment a metric for legacy-routing-usage.

Jon Park: I can add a lint rule to flag server-side code that constructs `routing_hint` as string and update the docs: https://redwood.docs/internal/api/routing.md (will update the examples).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-service/shim-parsing -> canary at 2026-03-22T02:00Z if PR merged by EOD. :rocket:

Alex Chen: plan: I'll implement the shim in the API layer + unit tests. Jon: you do docs + lint. Priya: add metric + response header warning. Marco: can you review the PR and add integration tests for the fallback order? Lisa: coordinate SDK patch to parse both shapes and drop legacy string after 2 months.

Marco Silva: noted, I'll add integration tests that simulate: explicit model id string, region:tier string, and full object. also add fuzzing for weird strings.

Lisa Turner: ok, will prepare the SDK patch and a short migration note for customers.

Alex Chen: rough timeline: shim & tests today, PR for review tonight, canary next week (per deploy-bot). If anything blocks CR, ping me directly. @Marco Silva for review.

Priya Nair: also add a small schema change in the API docs that says `routing_hint` accepts `object | string (legacy)` and show examples.

Jon Park::+1: I'll add the docs and a mention in the changelog.

Marco Silva: assigning review to myself, will try to get to it by 17:00 PST.

Lisa Turner: ack, will queue the SDK patch after the canary looks good.

Alex Chen: thanks all — tagging the checklist in case we need to follow up: alex (shim+tests), jon (docs+lint), priya (metrics+header), marco (CR+integration), lisa (sdk).

Jon Park: heads up — I also added a very small test in the router to ensure the KV cache key includes normalized routing so we don't accidentally split caches.

Priya Nair: nice catch. that avoids cache fragmentation.

Marco Silva: all right, will review now.

Lisa Turner: :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: closing this thread, will reopen if post-canary issues show up.
